assertions: The documented public appreviews endpoint returns a bounded updated-time cursor page for Steam app 620 without an account or API key.
The page contains at most five reviews, a usable next cursor, and a first-page query summary whose count matches the page.
Normalized reviews retain recommendation ID, timestamps, recommendation, purchase context and playtime-at-review while removing SteamID, profile, name, avatar and cross-review author linkage.
The Git verification snapshot stores only review length and SHA-256, not user-generated review text.
Coverage states cursor-page, corpusComplete=false, off-topic filtering and transient runtime text retention.
